title: Sociology, B.A. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Historical catalog-year build (2024-2025 archived bulletin edition), fetched raw HTML directly from the source URL above (curl, not WebFetch's summarizer, per this batch's anti-confabulation instruction) and cross-checked its own printed subtotals. Program Requirements are identical in substance to 2026: same 7 prescribed courses (CAS 283, SOC 1, SOC 207, SOC 400W, SOC 405, SOC 470, STAT 200), same 'Select 15 credits in sociology, at least 9 at the 400 level' bucket, same General Education 45 / Electives 20 / B.A. Degree Requirements 24 / Requirements for the Major 38 credit-distribution table. Real, confirmed difference from 2026: this edition's Suggested Academic Plan does NOT have the 'LA 83' (First Year Fall, 1.5cr) or 'LA 283' (Second Year Spring, 1.5cr, 2026.json's 'Second-Year Liberal Arts Seminar' slot) lines that the 2025-2026 and 2026-2027 editions add -- instead this edition's flowchart just has a generic 'General Education Course or First-Year Seminar' line in that slot with no dedicated second-year seminar at all, and its own printed Suggested Academic Plan totals are University Park 123 credits / Commonwealth Campuses 123 credits (vs. 126/124.5 for 2025 and 2026) -- both LA 83 and the Semester-4 equivalent slot were removed from this file and each semester's target_credits reduced by 1.5 to match (17.5->16 for Semester 1, 16.5->15 for Semester 4; net plan total 126->123, matching the bulletin's own stated minimum exactly). This edition also already uses 'World Cultures' (not 'Other Cultures') terminology, matching 2026, so that label is unchanged from the 2026 file. SOC/STAT/CAS course descriptions (bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2024-2025/university-course-descriptions/undergraduate/{soc,stat}/) were spot-checked for this edition and match 2026's: STAT 200's prerequisite is the literal 'Placement into MATH 21 or higher' (same wording every year 2022-2026), so this plan keeps 2026.json's real MATH 3 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 21 chain fix unchanged (STAT 200 was never itself scheduled with that prereq met otherwise). SOC 207 ('Prerequisite: 3 credits in Sociology' in 2022, 'Prerequisite at Enrollment: 3 credits in SOC' from 2023 on -- identical substance, cosmetic 'at Enrollment' wording added), SOC 405 (same '3 credits in Sociology/SOC'), SOC 470 ('Prerequisite: SOC 207'), and SOC 400W ('Prerequisite: SOC 470') are all unchanged from 2026. Since this app's soc_catalog.json is a single shared catalog file used by every catalog year of this major (not versioned per year, confirmed via Backend/catalogs/soc_catalog.json), the additional AND-prereq sequencing fixes 2026.json's own notes describe (SOC 207 -> SOC 1 approximation for the '3 credits in SOC' text; SOC 470 also needs STAT 200; SOC 400W also needs SOC 405 -- both from the bulletin's own program-requirements PDF footnote, not the plain course-description prereq field) already apply to this year's plan for free.
